The PyTorch repository and source distributions bundle several libraries that are
compatibly licensed. We list these here.

For Hygon PyTorch source releases that use a matched standalone third-party
source bundle, the complete third-party license texts and additional attribution
materials are expected to be delivered with that standalone bundle.
